title: INC-090: fraud refresh stalls checkout
body: Closed incident, 2026-08-22 09:40–10:05 UTC, ap-south-1. fraud-service feature refresh held a reader lock. Checkout requests timed out before payment authorization began. Payment-api and provider-adapter had no corresponding error increase. Deferring refresh cleared the stall; payment-client pool settings were unchanged. Follow RB-003 to distinguish this path.
